translationRepairs: Dou Luge — a forebear in his line had served as prefect of Tongzhou; the ancestral name is not preserved in the received text.
Dou Luge; ancestral register [lacuna]; [someone had been] prefect of Tongzhou.
Chinese 豆盧革，祖籍，同州刺史 is elliptical/lacunose; the idiomatic invents an unnamed forebear and claims the ancestral name is unpreserved, which belongs to the separate Xuanhe note.
His father Zan was prefect of Shu.
His father Zan was prefect of Shuzhou (舒州).
Chinese 舒州 is Shuzhou, not Shu (蜀); "Shu" confuses the prefecture name with the Sichuan region.
